source_text: In aquis quae pinnulas et squamas habent munda. Squamae virtutum; pinnae — motus ad superiora. Sine his demersi.
pass_a_gloss: In waters which fins and scales have clean. Scales of-virtues; fins — motion to higher-things. Without these sunk.
pass_b_english: In the waters, what has [[fins and scales is clean >> Bible:Leviticus 11:9]]. Scales are virtues; fins move upward. Without them you sink.
